items.title: Ex-Ramp engineers raise $20M for platform Melius after scrapping their first product
items.summary: Instead of helping marketers manage and optimize ad spend, the company is focusing on building the tools that generate the creative assets and campaigns.

items.title: How AI decision models could change content moderation
items.summary: On Tuesday, Musubi announced a lightweight decision model made for real-time moderation called PolicyLM-1.7B, released with open weights.

items.title: AI computing startup Lambda to raise $4B ahead of planned IPO
items.summary: Nvidia-backed Lambda is raising up to $4 billion at a $14.5 billion pre-money valuation ahead of a planned 2027 IPO, led by Coatue and Blackstone.

items.title: The next hurdle for AI agents: getting websites to let them in
items.summary: Personal AI agents promise to shop, book flights, and make reservations for you. But deliberate blocks and anti-bot defenses are getting in the way, leaving consumers caught in the middle. A new standard aims to help.

items.title: Hark releases an AI personal assistant with a focus on privacy
items.summary: The AI lab's personal assistant is an operating system from the future designed to compete with Muse, Dots, and Instinct.

items.title: Mirror Particle is building a ‘world model’ of human behavior
items.summary: Mirror Particle will launch at TechCrunch Disrupt's Startup Battlefield 200 with a world model built from scratch to predict human behavior, arguing that LLM role-play falls short for market research and brand strategy.

items.title: Anthropic is giving startups a free year of Claude Team and $1,000 in credits
items.summary: "We created this program because we believe the benefits of AI will reach most people through the companies that build on top of models, rather than through the models alone."

items.title: LibreOffice says ‘no AI’ is now a software feature
items.summary: The maker of the open source document editor says it has no plans to add AI to its software's default configuration, citing user privacy.

items.title: Mistral’s new 1T model aims to leapfrog closed and open rivals
items.summary: French AI lab Mistral AI has released Mistral Large 4, a new large multimodal model aiming to leapfrog both American and Chinese rivals.

items.title: Pinterest’s AI now turns beauty Pins into action plans
items.summary: Pinterest’s new AI-powered Beauty Guides translate hair and nail Pins into salon terminology, with estimated costs, appointment times, and maintenance needs.

items.title: Get all your questions answered at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: The full breakout session agenda revealed
items.summary: Get all of your scaling and tech questions answered at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026. Here's the full breakout session agenda, happening October 13-15 in San Francisco. Register now to join and save up to $100, and get a second pass at 50% off.

items.title: OpenAI will start watermarking ChatGPT’s text in the EU
items.summary: OpenAI will watermark ChatGPT and Codex text in the EU to comply with the AI Act. Editing can make the invisible marks harder to detect, it says.

items.title: Reflection debuts Beam, an open-weight AI model to rival Chinese models at lower compute cost
items.summary: Reflection is aiming Beam and future models at enterprises and sovereign nations. The pitch is to build “AI factories,” a product that would let institutions build their own customized, local AI system by training Reflection’s AI models on their own proprietary data.

items.title: Instinct brings its AI agent to group chats, even for friends without an account
items.summary: Instinct is launching group chats that let friends use its AI agent together for tasks like planning trips, organizing carpools, and coordinating events. The company says personal accounts remain separate, with permission required before personal agents share information or take action.

items.title: TikTok rolls out an AI shopping assistant and one-click checkout
items.summary: TikTok describes its new Shopping Assistant as a conversational AI agent designed to help users discover and purchase products.

items.title: Hot Girl Hotline is like ‘Dear Abby’ for the AI era
items.summary: Founded by two sisters, Hot Girl Hotline uses AI to give young women personalized dating and relationship advice, with an emphasis on safety and avoiding emotional dependency.

items.title: HackerRank’s AI interviewer offers a glimpse into what job interviews could become
items.summary: HackerRank’s AI interviewer has already conducted more than 500,000 interviews, with Snowflake, Snorkel, and Capgemini among its early testers.

items.title: OpenAI launches visual ads that appear alongside image generation results
items.summary: The new ads will begin to appear later this month in the U.S. only for now, and will feature products and services from an initial test group of advertisers.
